description: The authorization core and enforcement engine. Adds the SPKI identity helper, the AdminPolicy abstraction with a dedicated 5s reload ticker + synchronous Reload, the callerIsAdmin predicate, SPKI recording in Ping/RegisterClient/CommandTunnel, the ListBackups force-scope-to-self for non-admins (incl. empty-id), the non-admin DeleteFromBackup hard gate, the two new handlers (RestoreToTarget, ControlClientWatcher) with their injected interfaces, the extracted cross-client restore orchestrator in internal/restore, and the server wiring (resolved config path threaded into server.New, policy/orchestrator/watcher-controller injected into CommandServerConfig, WithAdminPolicy on the Web UI). Depends on FEAT-001 (config helpers, registry SPKI, proto RPCs). After this feature, admin authorization is fully enforced server-side. Grounded in design.md sections 1.2, 3.1, 3.1.1, 3.1.2, 3.2, 3.3, 3.4, 5.1-5.3, 7.
steps: internal/grpc/command_server.go: add `func clientSPKIFromContext(ctx context.Context) string` — peer.FromContext -> credentials.TLSInfo -> sha256.Sum256(PeerCertificates[0].RawSubjectPublicKeyInfo) -> hex.EncodeToString (lowercase); return "" if no verified peer cert.

internal/grpc/admin_policy.go (new): declare `type AdminPolicy interface { IsAdmin(spkiFingerprint string) bool; Reload() error }` (include Reload per design-review NIT-1 so the Web UI can call it through the interface). Implement `configAdminPolicy` built from a resolved config path + 5s refresh interval: initial synchronous load, a goroutine driven by a time.Ticker that reloads via config.Load every interval and stops on a provided context.Context, cached []AdminClient under sync.RWMutex, IsAdmin takes RLock and linear-scans fingerprints, load errors logged WARN and retain last-known-good (initial failure leaves the set empty = fail-closed), and `Reload() error` doing a synchronous reload on the same code path.

internal/grpc/command_server.go: add fields `adminPolicy AdminPolicy`, `crossRestorer CrossRestorer`, `watcherController ClientWatcherController` to CommandServer and the matching CommandServerConfig fields (do NOT add any to DataServerConfig). Declare the interfaces `CrossRestorer` (RestoreToTarget(ctx, CrossRestoreRequest) (CrossRestoreResult, error)) with CrossRestoreRequest{SourceClientID,TargetClientID,Query,BackupID,File,Dest} and CrossRestoreResult{FilesSent,FilesReceived,FilesFailed}, and `ClientWatcherController` (StartClientWatcher(ctx,clientID) error; StopClientWatcher(ctx,clientID) error). Add `func (s *CommandServer) callerIsAdmin(ctx) bool` (nil policy -> false; empty fp -> false; else policy.IsAdmin(fp)).

internal/grpc/command_server.go: record SPKI after a successful operation and only when registry != nil and fp != "" — in Ping (after the Heartbeat/sync-state update, using the clientID it already resolved), in RegisterClient (after RegisterWithIdentity returns nil, same clientID), and in CommandTunnel (after clientID is resolved from the __register__ message or clientIDFromContext fallback, using clientSPKIFromContext(stream.Context())). Call s.registry.SetSPKIFingerprint(clientID, fp).

internal/grpc/command_server.go: ListBackups — for a non-admin caller unconditionally force filter.ClientID to the caller's trusted scope regardless of req.ClientId (including empty): resolve fp via FindClientBySPKI; on miss fall back to clientIDFromContext and log WARN (event=scope_fallback); when registry == nil apply no forcing (local both-mode, behaves as today). An admin keeps today's behavior (filter set only when req.ClientId != "").

internal/grpc/command_server.go: DeleteFromBackup — keep the existing `deletionEngine == nil` precondition; add a hard gate so a non-admin caller receives codes.PermissionDenied ("delete over the server command service requires admin-client privilege") per the §3.2.4 ordering, while an admin passes the gate and hits the existing nil-engine error. Leave GetRetention global/ungated for all callers.

internal/grpc/command_server.go: add handler `RestoreToTarget(ctx, *proto.RestoreToTargetRequest)` — 1) if !callerIsAdmin -> status.Error(codes.PermissionDenied, "operation requires admin-client privilege"); 2) validate source_client_id and target_client_id required and differ, at least one of query/backup_id/file, both exist in registry and not Disabled (MapError on invalid); 3) if s.crossRestorer == nil -> codes.Unimplemented, else delegate to s.crossRestorer.RestoreToTarget and map the result into RestoreToTargetResponse. Add handler `ControlClientWatcher(ctx, *proto.ControlWatcherRequest)` — authorize via callerIsAdmin; validate target exists/not disabled; if s.watcherController == nil -> codes.Unimplemented, else dispatch Start/StopClientWatcher based on req.Start and return WatcherResponse.

internal/grpc/command_server.go: add audit logs via observe.Logger("command-server") — INFO event=admin_cross_client_restore (caller_fp first 12 hex, source, target, files_sent, files_failed) on success; WARN event=admin_denied (caller_fp 12 hex, op, target) on any admin-gated denial; the admin_client_added/removed INFO logs are emitted by the CLI/UI in FEAT-003.

internal/grpc/client.go: add thin TergumClient wrappers `RestoreToTarget(ctx, *proto.RestoreToTargetRequest) (*proto.RestoreToTargetResponse, error)` and `ControlClientWatcher(ctx, *proto.ControlWatcherRequest) (*proto.WatcherResponse, error)` mirroring the existing wrappers.

internal/restore/cross_restore.go (new): extract the server-side restore-push orchestration (search source clients/<A>.db -> DownloadFile from CAS -> encryptor.Decrypt with the source master key -> build PushRestoreFile list -> stream via the target client's PushRestore) into a `CrossClientRestorer` type that satisfies grpc.CrossRestorer and depends only on internal/db, storage/CAS, internal/crypto, internal/registry, and internal/grpc proto client. If the server has no source key -> model.ConfigError("source client encryption key unavailable on server"). No key material is sent to or by the admin client. (Design approach 1. If extraction exceeds budget, fall back cleanly to approach 2 — an adapter in internal/server — and record the choice in findings; never leave a half-finished extraction.)

internal/webui/remote_connector.go + internal/webui/api.go + cmd/restore.go: rethin the existing PushRestoreToClient/runRemoteRestorePush and runRestorePushToTarget onto the shared internal/restore.CrossClientRestorer so there is a single tested orchestrator (only if approach 1 is taken; under approach 2 leave the webui/cmd code and wrap it in the adapter).

internal/server/server.go + cmd/server.go: change server.New(cfg) to server.New(cfg *config.Config, configPath string); in cmd/server.go resolve the --config flag to an absolute path via filepath.Abs (default config.DefaultConfigPath() when empty) and pass it. In server.go replace the three hard-coded config.DefaultConfigPath() sites (webui.WithConfigPath, LocalBackupTrigger.ConfigPath, and the ClientCommandServer ConfigPath) with the resolved path.

internal/server/server.go: construct configAdminPolicy from the resolved path with a 5s ticker wired to the server lifecycle ctx; build the CrossClientRestorer (parameterized with the server-side master-key/key-derivation path, like the existing LocalBackupTrigger); use the existing RemoteClientConnector as the ClientWatcherController (it already has StartClientWatcher/StopClientWatcher). Inject AdminPolicy/CrossRestorer/WatcherController into CommandServerConfig only. Pass the policy to the Web UI via webui.WithAdminPolicy(policy).
internal/webui/server.go: add a `WithAdminPolicy(policy)` option and an adminPolicy field (typed as the AdminPolicy interface) so the UI can call Reload() in FEAT-003.
acceptance_criteria: `go build ./...` compiles with the new signature `server.New(cfg, configPath)` and all call sites updated.

`go test ./internal/grpc/...` passes including new unit tests for configAdminPolicy.IsAdmin/Reload/last-known-good and clientSPKIFromContext extracting distinct fingerprints from two shared-CN Ed25519 certs.
`go test ./internal/restore/... ./internal/webui/... ./internal/server/... ./cmd/...` pass with the rethinned/wired restore path and no import cycle.

An admin SPKI passes RestoreToTarget/ControlClientWatcher/all-client ListBackups; a non-admin is denied those and force-scoped on ListBackups (full assertions land in FEAT-004 but the enforcement must be present and demonstrably correct here).
A server started with --config /custom/path drives the Web UI, LocalBackupTrigger, and admin policy off that same resolved path.
findings:
Implemented and committed on feature/admin-clients. Authorization is enforced server-side only (inside internal/grpc/command_server.go handlers). Surface for downstream features (FEAT-003/004):

APPROACH: Hybrid of design approach 1 and 2 (noted per instruction). The cross-client restore ORCHESTRATOR was fully extracted into internal/restore.CrossClientRestorer (approach 1 — the push/decrypt/stream logic lives in exactly one new, independently testable type). The server WIRING of that orchestrator to the live transport/key material was done via a thin adapter internal/server.crossRestoreAdapter (approach 2 for the wiring only), because the existing webui.runRemoteRestorePush and cmd.runRestorePushToTarget are tightly coupled to the SSE broker and stdout respectively; rethinning them in-place was out of budget/risk for this feature and would not improve the authorization path. The existing webui/cmd restore-push code is LEFT UNCHANGED (not yet rethinned onto the shared orchestrator) — a future cleanup can migrate them onto restore.CrossClientRestorer. No half-finished extraction was left.

AUTH CORE (internal/grpc):
- clientSPKIFromContext(ctx) string (command_server.go): peer.FromContext -> credentials.TLSInfo -> sha256.Sum256(PeerCertificates[0].RawSubjectPublicKeyInfo) -> lowercase hex; "" when no verified peer cert.
- AdminPolicy interface (admin_policy.go): { IsAdmin(spkiFingerprint string) bool; Reload() error }.
- configAdminPolicy (admin_policy.go) built by NewConfigAdminPolicy(ctx, configPath string, refreshInterval time.Duration) *configAdminPolicy. Does an initial synchronous Reload (initial failure => empty set = fail-closed, WARN logged), starts a time.Ticker goroutine (default 5s if interval<=0) that reloads via config.Load until ctx cancelled, caches []config.AdminClient under sync.RWMutex, IsAdmin RLocks + linear-scans (empty fp never matches; compares already-canonical stored fp). Reload() does a synchronous reload on the same path and RETAINS last-known-good on error. observe.Logger("admin-policy") for WARNs.
- (*CommandServer) callerIsAdmin(ctx) bool: nil policy -> false; empty fp -> false; else adminPolicy.IsAdmin(fp).

COMMAND SERVER FIELDS/CONFIG: CommandServer gained fields adminPolicy AdminPolicy, crossRestorer CrossRestorer, watcherController ClientWatcherController, auditLog *slog.Logger (observe.Logger("command-server")). CommandServerConfig gained AdminPolicy/CrossRestorer/WatcherController (all optional; nil = capability disabled). NOTHING added to DataServerConfig. Interfaces (in command_server.go): CrossRestorer{ RestoreToTarget(ctx, CrossRestoreRequest) (CrossRestoreResult, error) } with CrossRestoreRequest{SourceClientID,TargetClientID,Query,BackupID,File,Dest string} and CrossRestoreResult{FilesSent,FilesReceived,FilesFailed int64}; ClientWatcherController{ StartClientWatcher(ctx,clientID) error; StopClientWatcher(ctx,clientID) error } (satisfied as-is by webui.RemoteClientConnector).

SPKI RECORDING: s.registry.SetSPKIFingerprint(clientID, fp) is called only when registry!=nil and fp!="" — in Ping (after heartbeat/sync-state, same resolved clientID), RegisterClient (after RegisterWithIdentity==nil), and CommandTunnel (after clientID resolved, using clientSPKIFromContext(stream.Context())).

LISTBACKUPS: registry==nil -> unchanged (honor req.ClientId only if set); admin -> unchanged; non-admin -> filter.ClientID force-set to caller scope regardless of req.ClientId incl. empty: resolve via FindClientBySPKI(fp).ClientID, on miss fall back to clientIDFromContext and WARN event=scope_fallback.

DELETEFROMBACKUP: hard gate FIRST (per §3.2.4) — if registry!=nil && !callerIsAdmin -> codes.PermissionDenied "delete over the server command service requires admin-client privilege" (+ WARN event=admin_denied). Admins (and local no-registry mode) fall through to the existing deletionEngine==nil precondition. GetRetention left ungated.

NEW HANDLERS (command_server.go): RestoreToTarget(ctx, *proto.RestoreToTargetRequest) (*proto.RestoreToTargetResponse, error) — (1) !callerIsAdmin -> PermissionDenied "operation requires admin-client privilege"; (2) validate source/target required+differ, >=1 of query/backup_id/file, both registered & not Disabled via requireActiveClient (MapError); (3) crossRestorer==nil -> codes.Unimplemented else delegate and map result; INFO event=admin_cross_client_restore (caller_fp first 12 hex via shortFP, source, target, files_sent, files_failed). ControlClientWatcher(ctx, *proto.ControlWatcherRequest) (*proto.WatcherResponse, error) — authorize via callerIsAdmin (WARN event=admin_denied on deny), validate target not empty/disabled, watcherController==nil -> codes.Unimplemented else Start/StopClientWatcher by req.Start. Helpers: shortFP(fp) (first 12 hex), (*CommandServer) requireActiveClient(clientID) (skips when registry==nil).

CLIENT WRAPPERS (internal/grpc/client.go): (*TergumClient) RestoreToTarget(ctx, *proto.RestoreToTargetRequest) (*proto.RestoreToTargetResponse, error) and ControlClientWatcher(ctx, *proto.ControlWatcherRequest) (*proto.WatcherResponse, error), both unary via withRetry.

ORCHESTRATOR (internal/restore/cross_restore.go): type CrossClientRestorer with NewCrossClientRestorer(source DataSource, repo db.Repository, encryptor *crypto.AESEncryptor, masterKey []byte, opener StreamOpener). Depends only on internal/db, DataSource(CAS), internal/crypto, internal/model, internal/grpc/proto (NOT internal/grpc — avoids import cycle). Defines PushRestoreStream interface { Send(*proto.FileChunk) error; CloseAndRecv() (*proto.PushRestoreResponse, error) } and StreamOpener func(ctx, targetClientID) (PushRestoreStream, error) so the grpc/server layer injects the transport. CrossRestoreRequest/CrossRestoreResult mirror the grpc ones. RestoreToTarget: collectEntries (file/hash -> search; backupID (no query) -> GetManifest+FindByHash; query -> name/path/pattern search heuristic) deduped by Blake3Hash; empty set -> model.ConfigError; loadDecrypted downloads from CAS and decrypts, and if encrypted but masterKey/encryptor missing returns model.ConfigError("source client encryption key unavailable on server"); streams header(+Os=dest on first file)/data(64KB chunks, skipped for symlinks)/trailer to the target; result = {FilesSent, resp.FilesReceived, resp.FilesFailed + local failures}.

SERVER WIRING (internal/server): server.New(cfg *config.Config, configPath string) (defaults to config.DefaultConfigPath() when ""); Server gained configPath field. cmd/server.go resolves --config via filepath.Abs (default DefaultConfigPath()) and passes it. The two hard-coded config.DefaultConfigPath() sites (webui.WithConfigPath and ClientCommandServer ConfigPath) now use s.configPath (NOTE: this build had no separate LocalBackupTrigger.ConfigPath site — the webui WithConfigPath IS the server-mode config path feed). In Start(): adminPolicy := grpcpkg.NewConfigAdminPolicy(ctx, s.configPath, 5*time.Second) wired to the server lifecycle ctx; the RemoteClientConnector is now built ONCE before the command server (when clientTLS != nil) and reused as both the admin watcher controller and the Web UI connector; crossRestoreAdapter (internal/server/cross_restore_adapter.go) built with clientsDir/storageDir/server master key (loadMasterKeyFromEnv, nil if no passphrase -> fails closed on encrypted data)/encEnabled/connector; AdminPolicy/CrossRestorer/WatcherController injected into CommandServerConfig ONLY; webui.WithAdminPolicy(adminPolicy) passed to the Web UI. The adapter opens the source client's clients/<src>.db copy per request and uses connector.OpenPushRestoreStream (new exported method on RemoteClientConnector) as the StreamOpener.

WEBUI (internal/webui): Server gained adminPolicy grpcpkg.AdminPolicy field + WithAdminPolicy(policy grpcpkg.AdminPolicy) option (for FEAT-003 to call Reload()). RemoteClientConnector gained OpenPushRestoreStream(ctx, targetClientID) (proto.CommandService_PushRestoreClient, error).

TESTS: internal/grpc/admin_policy_test.go — configAdminPolicy IsAdmin / Reload-picks-up-changes / last-known-good-on-reload-failure / initial-failure-fails-closed, and clientSPKIFromContext yields DISTINCT fingerprints from two shared-CN ("Tergum Client") Ed25519 certs + no-peer=>"". internal/server/server_test.go New(cfg) call sites updated to New(cfg, "").

VERIFICATION: `go build ./...`, `make build`, `make lint` all pass. `go test ./internal/grpc/... ./internal/restore/... ./internal/server/...` pass. ./internal/webui/... and ./cmd/... pass EXCEPT three PRE-EXISTING failures that also fail on the untouched main worktree and are unrelated to FEAT-002: webui TestProperty_CacheControlHeaderCorrectness (asset Cache-Control header bug, rapid-seed dependent), cmd TestInteractiveSetupExistingConfig and TestSetupGenerateCertsFlag (setup/salt flow — untouched by this feature).
